findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: studio_generation_quote, studio_generation_wait, studio_motion_wait, studio_motion_catalogue · Private data: studio_song_attach, studio_artist_photo, studio_media_upload_widget, studio_media_upload_url, studio_media_import_url, studio_video_preview, studio_video_export, studio_generation_confirm, studio_ai_sharing_choose, studio_video_status, studio_storyboard_approve, studio_storyboard_likeness_record, studio_storyboard_look_accept, studio_motion_create, studio_credits_balance_read, studio_credit_usage_list · Public sink: studio_video_plan, studio_video_start, studio_song_attach, studio_songs_list, studio_song_status, studio_artist_photo, studio_media_upload_widget, studio_media_upload_url, studio_media_confirm, studio_media_import_url, studio_artist_create · Destructive: studio_generation_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: studio_generation_quote, studio_generation_wait, studio_motion_wait, studio_motion_catalogue · Private data: studio_song_attach, studio_artist_photo, studio_media_upload_widget, studio_media_upload_url, studio_media_import_url, studio_video_preview, studio_video_export, studio_generation_confirm, studio_ai_sharing_choose, studio_video_status, studio_storyboard_approve, studio_storyboard_likeness_record, studio_storyboard_look_accept, studio_motion_create, studio_credits_balance_read, studio_credit_usage_list · Public sink: studio_video_plan, studio_video_start, studio_song_attach, studio_songs_list, studio_song_status, studio_artist_photo, studio_media_upload_widget, studio_media_upload_url, studio_media_confirm, studio_media_import_url, studio_artist_create · Destructive: studio_generation_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
